WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.type, t.amount
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.date > '1996-05-09' AND t.date < '1998-01-06'
),
trans_with_district AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region,
    CASE WHEN ft.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN ft.amount
         WHEN ft.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -ft.amount
         ELSE NULL END AS signed_amount
  FROM filtered_trans ft
  JOIN account a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
regional_stats AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count
  FROM trans_with_district
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS overall_average FROM regional_stats
)
SELECT rs.region, rs.avg_signed_amount, rs.trans_count,
  rs.avg_signed_amount / oa.overall_average AS ratio
FROM regional_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rs.region;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with type other than 'PRIJEM' or 'VYDAJ' (including 'VYBER' and NULL types) are excluded from the average signed amount calculation, per the request to exclude "any other or missing type". Such transactions still contribute to the regional transaction count.

If a region has transactions in the date range but none with type 'PRIJEM' or 'VYDAJ', its avg_signed_amount is NULL and its ratio is NULL; such a region is included in the output if the overall average is not NULL.
